movelist.name: Gyro Ball
movelist.effect: The target reveals their Speed Stat (including Combat Stages). If it is higher than the user’s (again, including Combat Stages), subtract the user’s Speed Stat from the target’s, and apply the difference as Bonus Damage.

movelist.name: Mimic
movelist.effect: Choose a Move that the target has used during the encounter. For the remainder of the encounter, that Move replaces Mimic on the user’s Move List. Mimic cannot miss.

movelist.name: Body Slam
movelist.effect: Body Slam Paralyzes the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Rest
movelist.effect: The user is set to their full Hit Point value. The user is cured of any Status ailments. Then, the user falls Asleep. The user cannot make Sleep Checks at the beginning of their turn. They are cured of the Sleep at the end of their turn in 2 rounds.

movelist.name: Wake-Up Slap
movelist.effect: If the target is Asleep, Wake-Up Slap has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead, and cures the target of Sleep.

movelist.name: Round
movelist.effect: Round’s Damage Base is equal to 6, plus +2 more for each previous use of Round by any Trainer or Pokémon this round, up to a maximum of DB12.

abilities.name: Lullaby
abilities.effect: Connection - Sing. Whenever the user uses the Move “Sing”, they may activate this Feature. The user then picks a Pokémon or Trainer being targeted by Sing; Sing automatically hits that target.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Base Attack stat is doubled. This may double any bonuses from Nature or Vitamins, but not bonuses from Trainer Features.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls against adjacent targets.
